description: This Java class 'NamespaceReader' provides static methods to parse and extract namespace information from entity identifiers within the Eclipse Ditto project. It supports extraction from generic strings, EntityId instances, and NamespacedEntityId instances, utilizing a colon ':' as the namespace separator.

classes.name: NamespaceReader
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to parse namespaces from entity identifiers.

methods.name: fromEntityId (EntityId id)
methods.description: Extracts the namespace from an EntityId object, either directly if it's a NamespacedEntityId or by converting it to string.

methods.name: fromEntityId (String id)
methods.description: Extracts the namespace from a string identifier by parsing until the namespace separator ':'.

methods.name: fromEntityId (NamespacedEntityId id)
methods.description: Returns the namespace associated with a NamespacedEntityId.
